name: Agriculture, Planting, Crop Growth & Harvest Runtime
design_rules: crops begin from explicit seed stock and prepared plots
crop growth depends on water fertility temperature and elapsed world time
poor conditions slow growth instead of imposing arbitrary mission locks
harvest yield depends on crop health and maturity
harvest returns food and may return seed for future planting
soil preparation and composting change persistent plot properties
irrigation consumes supplied water rather than creating moisture from nothing
agriculture never uses emissive or glow feedback
